summary: Global Ship Lease filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report on Form 8-K) attaching an October 12, 2026 press release announcing a new $1 billion syndicated loan facility priced at SOFR + 1.5% with a seven-year duration. The facility funds 15 newbuildings announced in June, drawn in delivery-linked tranches spanning late 2028 through 2030, with each vessel fixed to commence time charters on delivery. Bank of America acts as bookrunner, mandated lead arranger, facility and security agent; seven additional top-tier banks participate. This is a routine credit facility, not a special situation; watch delivery pacing, drawdown timing, and charter counterparty risk.
